powah.guide.intro.en_us:
Powah generates, stores and transmits Forge Energy (FE). Start by crafting Dielectric Paste from coal, clay and a lava bucket.
Progress through Starter, Basic, Hardened, Blazing, Niotic, Spirited and Nitro tiers. Energizing unlocks the advanced materials.
Use a Wrench in air to cycle rotation, side configuration and linking. Sneak-use a machine to dismantle it. Stored energy and fluids are preserved; inventory contents are returned.
If Ponder is installed, hover over a machine and hold W, or use the Ponder link. Scroll to read longer pages.
powah.guide.intro.zh_cn:
Powah 用于产生、储存和传输 Forge 能量（FE）。首先用煤炭、黏土和一桶熔岩制作绝缘膏。
设备依次分为入门、基础、硬化、烈焰、钻石、绿宝石、终极七级。高级材料需要充能合成。
对空气使用扳手可切换旋转、侧面配置和连接模式。潜行右键拆卸机器，保留能量和流体，返还内部物品。
安装 Ponder 后，悬停机器物品按住 W，或点击思索教程链接。较长页面可滚轮阅读。

powah.guide.power.en_us:
Furnator: insert furnace fuel in the fuel slot. One coal yields 48,000 FE by default. A full buffer pauses fuel use.
Magmator: fill with lava using a bucket or fluid pipe. One bucket yields 100,000 FE.
Thermo Generator: supply water, and place lava, magma or a Blazing Crystal Block below it. Water use is 1 mB per 40 active ticks.
Solar Panel: needs clear sky and daylight. An installed Lens of Ender bypasses obstructions. It still needs daylight.
Energy Cells store FE. Connect generators with Energy Cables; the slowest cable limits the path. Use side buttons to choose input, output or disabled. Both slots on the left of an Energy Cell charge items; Furnators, Magmators and Thermo Generators use their lower-left slot.
powah.guide.power.zh_cn:
熔炉发电机：燃料槽放入原版熔炉燃料。默认一块煤产生 48,000 FE；储能满时暂停消耗。
熔岩发电机：使用桶或流体管注入熔岩，每桶产生 100,000 FE。
热力发电机：供给水，并在下方放置熔岩、岩浆块或烈焰水晶块。工作时每 40 刻消耗 1 mB 水。
太阳能板：需要白天且上方无遮挡；装入末影透镜可以绕过遮挡，仍需日光。
能量单元储存 FE。用能量线缆连接发电机；传输受路径中最低等级线缆限制。侧面按钮配置输入、输出或关闭。能量单元左侧两格均可充电；熔炉、熔岩、热力发电机使用左下角的充电槽。

powah.guide.energizing.en_us:
Right-use an Energizing Orb to insert one ingredient. With an empty hand, retrieve an item; sneak-use to retrieve all. Pipes insert in slots 2-7 and extract from slot 1.
Power an Energizing Rod at its attached face. It finds the nearest orb within four blocks. Multiple rods can supply one orb. Wrench link mode selects an orb, then a rod.
Iron + gold: 2 Energized Steel, 10,000 FE. Blaze rod or 4 blaze powder: Blazing Crystal, 120,000 FE. Diamond: Niotic Crystal, 300,000 FE. Emerald: Spirited Crystal, 1,000,000 FE.
Nether star + 2 redstone blocks + Blazing Crystal Block: 16 Nitro Crystals, 20,000,000 FE. Each ingredient needs its own slot. Extract the completed result before adding the next recipe.
powah.guide.energizing.zh_cn:
右键充能球每次放入一个原料。空手右键取出一个物品，潜行空手右键全部取出。自动化从第 2～7 格输入、第 1 格输出。
从充能棒贴附的面输入能量，它会寻找四格内最近的充能球。多个棒可以同时供能；扳手连接模式先选球，再选棒。
铁锭＋金锭：2 个充能钢，10,000 FE。烈焰棒或 4 个烈焰粉：烈焰水晶，120,000 FE。钻石：钻石水晶，300,000 FE。绿宝石：绿宝石水晶，1,000,000 FE。
下界之星＋2 个红石块＋烈焰水晶块：16 个终极水晶，20,000,000 FE。每份原料单占一格；成品取出后才能继续放料。

powah.guide.reactor.en_us:
Carry 36 identical Reactor parts and place them in an empty 3 x 4 x 3 area. The clicked location is the bottom center. Placement consumes 36 parts.
Slots: lower-left chargeable item; center Uraninite; upper-left furnace fuel; bottom-left redstone; bottom-right solid coolant. Fluid pipes and buckets supply water. Ice, snowballs, packed ice, Blue Ice and Dry Ice are solid coolants.
The reactor stores up to 1,000 fuel units; each Uraninite adds 100. Coal and redstone improve efficiency. Water and solid coolant reduce temperature and fuel consumption.
Connect cables to the bottom center, four lower side centers or top center. Auto mode pauses at full storage and resumes at 70%.
Breaking any part dismantles the structure and refunds 36 parts plus its inventory. Stored energy and fluid travel with the returned parts.
powah.guide.reactor.zh_cn:
携带 36 个完全相同的反应堆部件，在 3×4×3 空地放置。点击位置是底部中心，放置消耗 36 个部件。
最左下槽位给物品充电；中间放晶质铀，左上放熔炉燃料，左下放红石，右下放固体冷却剂。用流体管或桶供水。冰、雪球、浮冰、蓝冰和干冰可作固体冷却剂。
燃料上限 1,000 单位，每颗晶质铀补充 100。煤和红石提高效率；水和固体冷却剂降低温度和耗燃料速度。
底面中心、四个底层侧面中心和顶面中心可输出能量。自动模式在储能满时暂停，降至 70% 后恢复。
拆掉任意部件会拆解整座结构，返还 36 个部件及内部物品；能量和流体保留在返还的部件上。

powah.guide.ender.en_us:
Ender Cells and Gates use a persistent network keyed by the placing player's UUID and the selected channel. Matching networks work across dimensions while their blocks are loaded.
A new channel has zero capacity. Open an Ender Cell and Shift-click an Energy Cell or Battery in your inventory. It is consumed, adding its capacity and existing energy permanently to that channel. The two visible slots on the left charge items.
Set an Ender Gate to the same channel. Power passes through its attached face. Different players and different channels remain isolated.
Higher tiers unlock up to 12 channels. Breaking an Ender Cell does not remove the channel's energy or capacity. Only its owner or an operator can change its configuration.
powah.guide.ender.zh_cn:
末影单元和末影门按放置玩家 UUID 与频道共享持久网络。对应方块保持加载时，跨维度也可传输。
新频道容量为零。打开末影单元，Shift + 点击背包里的能量单元或电池，会消耗该物品，永久把容量和已有能量加入频道。左侧两个可见槽位用于充电。
将末影门设为同一频道，从贴附的面输入或输出能量。不同玩家、不同频道彼此隔离。
高等级最多解锁 12 个频道。拆卸末影单元不会删除频道能量或容量。只有所属玩家或管理员能修改配置。

powah.guide.charging.en_us:
Use a Binding Card in the air to bind it to yourself. Put the card into a powered Player Transmitter to charge items in your inventory. Ordinary cards work in the same dimension.
Use a Binding Card on an Enderman or Endermite to make a Dimensional Binding Card; the entity is consumed. Existing player binding is preserved.
An Energy Hopper charges items in the inventory on its facing side. It supports vanilla containers and Forge modifiable item handlers. An Energy Discharger draws power from up to seven items and outputs FE.
Sneak-use a Battery to enable automatic charging of carried items. Batteries never charge each other. Use an Aerial Pearl on a zombie to obtain a Player Aerial Pearl. Use a Photoelectric Pane on an Enderman or Endermite for a Lens of Ender.
powah.guide.charging.zh_cn:
对空气使用绑定卡将其绑定自己。把卡放入已供能的玩家能量发射器，为背包物品充电。普通卡限同一维度。
用绑定卡右键末影人或末影螨，可消耗生物制成跨维度绑定卡，并保留玩家绑定。
能量漏斗给朝向容器内的物品充电，支持原版容器及 Forge 可修改物品处理器。能量放电器从最多七个物品提取能量并输出 FE。
潜行右键电池开启随身充电，电池不会相互充电。用天空珍珠右键僵尸获得玩家天空珍珠；用光电板右键末影人或末影螨获得末影透镜，均会消耗生物。

powah.guide.materials.en_us:
Uraninite has poor, regular and dense ores. Mine ores for Raw Uraninite, then smelt it, or energize it for double output. Energizing ore blocks yields 3, 5 or 10 Uraninite depending on richness.
In 1.12 terrain, poor ore generates at Y 4-63, regular ore at Y 4-23, and dense ore at Y 4-11. Dry Ice generates under cold biomes. Deepslate ores are available for custom worlds.
Blue Ice is supplied as powah:blue_ice because 1.12 lacks it. Craft it from 9 packed ice; energize 2 Blue Ice with 10,000 FE to make Dry Ice.
A Charged Snowball costs 500,000 FE and summons lightning on impact. Shared recipe ingredients use the Forge ore dictionary. Uranium ingots can be energized only when another mod supplies them.
powah.guide.materials.zh_cn:
晶质铀矿分贫矿、普通矿和富矿。挖矿得到粗晶质铀，熔炼为晶质铀，或充能获得双倍产量。按富集程度，矿石方块充能产出 3、5、10 颗晶质铀。
在 1.12 地形中，贫矿生成于 Y 4～63，普通矿 Y 4～23，富矿 Y 4～11。寒冷群系地下生成干冰。深板岩矿保留供自定义世界使用。
由于 1.12 没有蓝冰，补充 powah:blue_ice，配方为 9 个浮冰。2 个蓝冰消耗 10,000 FE 充能为干冰。
充能雪球消耗 500,000 FE 合成，命中后召唤闪电。通用材料使用 Forge 矿物词典；只有其他模组提供铀锭时，才可用铀锭充能。

powah.ponder.tag.energy.description.en_us: Generate, store, transmit and use Forge Energy.
powah.ponder.tag.energy.description.zh_cn: 产生、储存、传输和使用 Forge 能量。

powah.ponder.shared.power.1.en_us: Feed furnace fuel into a Furnator to generate Forge Energy.
powah.ponder.shared.power.1.zh_cn: 将熔炉燃料放入熔炉发电机，产生 Forge 能量。

powah.ponder.shared.power.2.en_us: Connect a generator to an Energy Cell using Energy Cables. The slowest cable limits the route.
powah.ponder.shared.power.2.zh_cn: 用能量线缆将发电机接到能量单元。路径中最慢的线缆决定传输上限。

powah.ponder.shared.power.3.en_us: Solar Panels need daylight; Thermo Generators need water and heat below. Magmators consume lava.
powah.ponder.shared.power.3.zh_cn: 太阳能板需要日光；热力发电机需要水和下方热源；熔岩发电机消耗熔岩。

powah.ponder.shared.energizing.1.en_us: Insert one item at a time into the Energizing Orb. Iron and gold make two Energized Steel.
powah.ponder.shared.energizing.1.zh_cn: 每次向充能球放入一个原料。铁锭加金锭可合成两个充能钢。

powah.ponder.shared.energizing.2.en_us: Power an Energizing Rod through its attached face. It automatically finds an orb within four blocks.
powah.ponder.shared.energizing.2.zh_cn: 从充能棒贴附的面供能。它会自动寻找四格内的充能球。

powah.ponder.shared.energizing.3.en_us: Several rods can charge one recipe. Extract the output before inserting the next recipe.
powah.ponder.shared.energizing.3.zh_cn: 多个充能棒可以同时为一个配方供能。先取出成品，再放入下一组原料。

powah.ponder.shared.reactor.1.en_us: Place 36 matching parts in a clear 3 x 4 x 3 space to assemble a Reactor.
powah.ponder.shared.reactor.1.zh_cn: 携带 36 个相同部件，在 3×4×3 空地放置，反应堆会自动组装。

powah.ponder.shared.reactor.2.en_us: Insert Uraninite. Coal and redstone improve efficiency; water and solid coolant lower temperature.
powah.ponder.shared.reactor.2.zh_cn: 加入晶质铀。煤和红石提高效率，水和固体冷却剂降低温度。

powah.ponder.shared.reactor.3.en_us: Output at bottom, lower side centers or top center. Removing a part refunds all 36 parts.
powah.ponder.shared.reactor.3.zh_cn: 从底面、底层侧面中心或顶面中心输出能量。拆下任意部件会返还全部 36 个部件。

powah.ponder.shared.ender.1.en_us: Ender Cells and Gates share energy across dimensions when owner and channel match.
powah.ponder.shared.ender.1.zh_cn: 所属玩家和频道相同的末影单元与末影门，可以跨维度共享能量。

powah.ponder.shared.ender.2.en_us: Open an Ender Cell and Shift-click an Energy Cell or Battery in your inventory. It is consumed to add its capacity and stored energy to the channel.
powah.ponder.shared.ender.2.zh_cn: 打开末影单元，Shift + 点击背包里的能量单元或电池，消耗物品，将容量与已有能量永久加入频道。

powah.ponder.shared.ender.3.en_us: Set an Ender Gate to the same channel. Its attached face provides wireless power.
powah.ponder.shared.ender.3.zh_cn: 将末影门设为同一频道，从贴附的面提供无线能量。

powah.ponder.shared.charging.1.en_us: Use a Binding Card in the air, then insert it into a powered Player Transmitter.
powah.ponder.shared.charging.1.zh_cn: 对空气使用绑定卡，再将其放入已供能的玩家能量发射器。

powah.ponder.shared.charging.2.en_us: Ordinary cards work in the same dimension. Upgrade the card using an Enderman for other dimensions.
powah.ponder.shared.charging.2.zh_cn: 普通卡限同维度。用卡右键末影人升级后，可跨维度为背包充电。

powah.ponder.shared.charging.3.en_us: Energy Hoppers charge container items; Dischargers extract energy. Sneak-use Batteries to enable portable charging.
powah.ponder.shared.charging.3.zh_cn: 能量漏斗给容器物品充电，放电器提取物品能量。潜行右键电池可开启随身充电。

powah.ui.ender_extend.en_us: Shift-click a cell or battery in your inventory to expand this channel.
powah.ui.ender_extend.zh_cn: Shift + 点击背包中的能量单元或电池，为当前频道扩容。

powah.ui.tank.en_us: With a container: left-click to insert, right-click to extract.
powah.ui.tank.zh_cn: 携带流体容器：左键注入，右键抽取。

powah.guide.search_hint.en_us: Type a word to search this guide.
powah.guide.search_hint.zh_cn: 输入关键词搜索手册内容。

powah.guide.interaction_recipe.en_us: Use the interaction described on this page.
powah.guide.interaction_recipe.zh_cn: 通过本页介绍的交互方式获得。
